subject: gk
question: Who elects the Presiding Officer (the speaker) in the State legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Members of Vidhan Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vidhan Sabha is the** lower house of the State Legislature in India.**
 
• The Speaker is elected from among the **elected members of the Legislative Assembly.**
 
• **Article 168**: It states that there shall be a legislature for each state, which **may consist of a Governor and one or two Houses.**
 
• **Article 173**: It provides the procedure for the **elections of members **of the Legislative Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 163: **It states that the Governor may seek the advice of the Council of Ministers
 
• **Article 164:** It provides for the establishment of a Council of Ministers to aid and advise the Governor in the exercise of his functions. The Chief Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers.
 
• **Article 167:** It outlines the duties of the Chief Minister, including keeping the Governor informed of all decisions of the Council of Ministers
 
• **Article 169:** Abolition or Creation of the Legislative Council.
 
• Article 170: Composition of the Legislative Assemblies.
 
• **Article 171:** Composition of the Legislative Councils.
